name: Mount Vernon Volunteer Program
org: George Washington's Mount Vernon (Mount Vernon Ladies' Association)
what_you_do: Volunteer at George Washington's home. Roles include the archaeology lab, greeting guests, helping at events (some in period clothes), gardening and greenhouse work, and helping staff who play historic characters.
pay_detail: Unpaid. Volunteers get discounts at the estate's shops and restaurants and special tours.
duration: At least 25 hours a year to stay active.
deadline_text: The page says volunteer applications are currently closed. No reopening date is posted.
how_to_apply: Watch the volunteering page for applications to reopen, or contact Joan Flintoft, Vice President for Hospitality, at 703-799-8605.
notes: About 250 active volunteers. Some roles, like driving, need an adult with a license, so not every role is open to teens. There is no archaeology fieldwork for volunteers right now, only lab work.
